title: Context Window Simulator: Monitoring Agent
description: Context Window Simulator built as a Monitoring agent. The context window caps how many tokens a model sees at once, and the KV cache grows linearly with it, which is why long contexts are memory-hungry. Sliding-window attention trades full coverage for constant memory, and retrieval can extend effective context beyond the window. The simulator models cache growth and latency versus window size. Samples synthetic topic metrics for N cycles, evaluates each reading against thresholds, prints readings and alerts.
resume_bullet: Built a Context Window Simulator monitoring agent in Python (stdlib) sampling synthetic CPU, memory, and latency metrics on a fixed cadence; evaluates threshold breaches and prints readings with alerts and a summary.

The scorer splits answers into atomic claims and runs entailment checks, producing a supported-claims ratio plus a list of orphan claims. This is the core metric for retrieval-augmented generation quality. An evaluation harness that runs test cases against a stub model, measures accuracy and latency, and adds an LLM-as-judge rubric score per case.
resume_bullet: Built a Groundedness Scorer in Python with seeded test cases, latency measurement, and an LLM-as-judge rubric scorer.

title: Guardrail Pipeline Simulator: Eval_Harness
description: Guardrail Pipeline Simulator built as a eval_harness. Guardrails are the layered defenses around a model: input filters, the model's own refusal training, output classifiers, and human review queues. Each layer catches different failures, and defense-in-depth means no single layer is trusted alone. The pipeline simulator chains seeded stages and measures end-to-end block rates per attack type. An evaluation harness that runs test cases against a stub model, measures accuracy and latency, and adds an LLM-as-judge rubric score per case.

Auth gateways protect MCP servers: clients present tokens on connect, the gateway validates scopes per tool, and expired tokens trigger re-authentication flows. An MCP server simulator that exposes echo, add, and word_count tools plus server info through JSON-RPC 2.0 request handling.
resume_bullet: Built a MCP Auth Gateway Simulator in Python implementing JSON-RPC 2.0 dispatch with a tool registry and structured error handling.

description: MCP Cancellation Flow Simulator built as a mcp_server_sim. title: MCP Capability Negotiator: Command-Line Tool
description: MCP Capability Negotiator built as a Command-line tool. Capability negotiation happens at session start: client and server exchange the features they support, such as tools, resources, sampling, and roots, and each side only uses the intersection. Version mismatches fall back to the common subset. The negotiator simulates seeded capability matrices and computes effective feature sets. A subcommand CLI that generates seeded synthetic topic rows and reports summaries, top-N rows, or filtered rows as tables or JSON.
resume_bullet: Built a MCP Capability Negotiator CLI tool in Python (argparse subcommands) over seeded synthetic data with table and JSON output; runs summary, top-N, and filter reports deterministically.

title: MCP Sampling Bridge: Agent_Loop_Sim
description: MCP Sampling Bridge built as a agent_loop_sim. Sampling lets a server ask the client to generate text: the server sends a sampling request, the client's model produces a completion, and the server continues its work. This inverts the usual direction so servers can use model intelligence mid-tool. The bridge simulates seeded sampling round trips with context limits. A ReAct-style agent loop simulator that cycles Thought, Action, and Observation over a calculator and a lookup table until it reaches a final answer.

title: Positional Encoding Explorer: Simulation (Logistic Growth)
description: Positional Encoding Explorer built as a Simulation (logistic growth). Attention is order-blind, so positional encodings inject sequence order: sinusoids give each position a unique smooth signature, and learned embeddings learn one per position. Relative schemes instead encode distances between tokens, which generalizes better to longer sequences. The explorer compares position similarity patterns across schemes. Euler-integrates logistic growth dP/dt = r*P*(1-P/K) and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.

title: Vector Similarity Search: Command-Line Tool

title: Vector Similarity Search: Simulation (Logistic Growth)
description: Vector Similarity Search built as a Simulation (logistic growth). Vector similarity search finds the stored vectors closest to a query vector, which powers semantic search over text, images, and recommendations. title: Watermark Detector: Eval_Harness
description: Watermark Detector built as a eval_harness. Watermarks embed detectable signals in generated text so outputs can be attributed to a model: green-list token biasing shifts word choice in a statistically detectable way without changing meaning. Detectors compute a z-score over the watermark statistic, and paraphrasing attacks try to wash it out. The simulator watermarks seeded text and measures detection under attack. An evaluation harness that runs test cases against a stub model, measures accuracy and latency, and adds an LLM-as-judge rubric score per case.
resume_bullet: Built a Watermark Detector in Python with seeded test cases, latency measurement, and an LLM-as-judge rubric scorer.
